children.textContent: One Hotel Opportunity Can Have Many Possible Futures.

Owners still manage brand, operator, capital, conversion, and strategic decisions across separate conversations, files, and assumptions. The process becomes difficult to compare long before the full potential of the opportunity is clear.
One hotel may have several credible futures.
Opportunity brief copied into four separate workstreams
The same opportunity is now being managed in several different places.
Responses With Different Information and Assumptions
Different Information. Different Assumptions. Different Levels of Detail.
The first path begins shaping the decision before the alternatives are fully understood.
Not because the hotel lacked options—but because the options were never evaluated through one connected process.

One hotel opportunity is handled through separate brand, operator, advisor, and capital conversations. Information becomes scattered across emails, decks, spreadsheets, calls, and PDFs. Responses arrive with different information and assumptions, making comparison difficult. One path may gain momentum before other credible options are fully tested, leaving potential value undiscovered.
